The [[Veril Line Systems/Legends|Veril Line Systems]] '''EG-4 power droid''' was [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] first modern [[Power droid/Legends|power droid]] model. Along with the [[EG-6 power droid/Legends|EG-6 power droid]], the EG-4 model dominated the energy-supply market.
